reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Milky Toner 200ml
reviews.text: love using this toner—this is already my second bottle! It’s gentle on the skin and doesn’t cause any irritation, making it perfect for everyday use.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意用呢支爽膚水——已經係第二枝喇！佢對皮膚溫和，唔會引起刺激，係日常使用嘅完美選擇。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Milky Toner 200ml
reviews.text: This is my first time trying this toner and it’s very hydrating, my skin soaks it up. I’m really liking it so far. My skin feels smooth and softer.
reviews.zh: 第一次試呢支爽膚水，保濕效果超強，皮膚一吸就吸收晒。到目前為止真係幾鍾意。皮膚感覺更滑更柔軟。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Milky Toner 200ml
reviews.text: I can’t say I’ve noticed any positive results yet and I’ve been using this for a little over a month now. It has a scent to it that I don’t really like, almost acidic or just not a really good smell? I was actually thinking it would be more of a milky consistency but it’s more liquidy than I thought. I won’t be repurchasing.
reviews.zh: 用咗一個月多啲，仲未見到有咩明顯嘅正面效果。佢有種味道我唔係幾鍾意，幾乎有啲酸嗰種感覺，又或者算係唔算好聞嘅味道？我本來以為佢會係乳液狀嘅質地，但實際上係比我預期更加水。我唔會再回購。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Milky Toner 200ml
reviews.text: A really underrated milky toner that absorbs so quickly. Doesn't break me out and makes my skin feel hydrated.
reviews.zh: 一支真係被低估嘅乳液狀爽膚水，吸收得好快。唔會令我爆瘡，而且令皮膚感覺水潤。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Milky Toner 200ml
reviews.text: good milky toner, i haven’t seen any other effects other than being quite moisturising but will continue using
reviews.zh: 唔錯嘅乳液狀爽膚水，除咗幾保濕之外，仲未見到其他特別效果，不過會繼續用落去。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Milky Toner 200ml
reviews.text: I cant wait to see how my skin looks after using this long term. So far it made my skin feel soft and feel a bit brighter in just a few uses.
reviews.zh: 好期待睇下長期用落去之後皮膚會變成點。用咗幾次之後，皮膚已經感覺柔軟咗，亦都有少少提亮嘅效果。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Milky Toner 200ml
reviews.text: Good ingredient list, I have used it for a couple of days and its all good for now, hope to see better results soon.
reviews.zh: 成分表唔錯，用咗幾日，暫時一切正常，希望好快會見到更好嘅效果。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Milky Toner 200ml
reviews.text:
טונר מעולה, משתמשת בו בבוקר. מכיל גלוטטיון שעוזר בפיגמנטציה, ההבטחות שמחליק את העור.
משתמשת כבר שבוע. נספג במהירות.
reviews.zh: 超讚嘅爽膚水，我朝早用緊。含有穀胱甘肽有助於對付色斑，聲稱可以令皮膚更滑。已經用咗一個星期，吸收得好快。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
